commentary: With market breadth languishing at 40 and the deterministic gate rated WEAK, Stan Weinstein's stage discipline and William O'Neil's market-direction rule mandate defensive positioning. In a volatile tape driven by heavy earnings dispersion and persistent FII portfolio outflows, even sound chart patterns encounter heightened failure rates. Jesse Livermore advocated that when the general market environment is under pressure, a disciplined trader sits tight and protects capital. Mark Minervini's SEPA framework requires progressive exposure—demanding confirmed Stage 2 leaders with accelerating fundamentals, tight VCP structures, and tight stops. Until breadth broadens above 50% and benchmarks confirm leadership accumulation, risk exposure should remain strictly curtailed.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Discipline

21STCENMGM.technical: Cleared a 20-day high pivot at 46.54 on 2.59× average volume, holding above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. While clearing short-term resistance, the micro-cap liquidity profile and loose price structure lack the symmetry of an institutional VCP.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Turned profitable in Q1 FY27 with ₹9.14 crore PAT, but preceding quarters suffered deep net losses. Negative ROCE (-57%) and volatile non-operating revenue sources fall far short of O'Neil's sustained CANSLIM investment criteria.
21STCENMGM.risk: A breach below 42.72 violates recent pivot support; cut losses immediately to avoid trapping capital in an erratic micro-cap.

63MOONS.technical: Constructing a double-bottom pattern challenging neckline resistance at 958.91, holding comfortably above its upward-sloping 50 and 200 SMAs. RSI at 62 confirms constructive momentum, though volatility within the base remains slightly elevated.
63MOONS.fundamental: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue grew +81% YoY to ₹171 crore, but the company posted an operating loss with net loss widening to ₹48 crore. Low leverage is positive, but negative returns on equity fail CANSLIM standards.
63MOONS.risk: Failure to clear 958.91 or a breakdown below 870.85 invalidates the double bottom; trigger an immediate risk cut.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Printed a new 52-week high clearing its 20-day breakout pivot at 110.11 with an RSI of 70, remaining well above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. However, price is approaching short-term overbought levels without a prior tight base contraction.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction with Q1 FY27 sales sinking -56.3% YoY to ₹44.6 crore and net profit dropping -25.5% YoY to ₹1.02 crore. Low ROCE of 5.6% and poor interest coverage fail CANSLIM quality filters.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A close below 100.50 invalidates the breakout attempt; execute strict Minervini stop discipline to prevent deep capital drawdowns.

AARTIIND.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 552.30 pivot on 2.23× average volume, well-positioned above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Price action shows clean accumulation and steady relative-strength improvement.
AARTIIND.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM earnings acceleration; Q1 FY27 PAT rose 260% YoY to ₹155 crore on 42.5% revenue growth. Operating margins expanded to 14.7%; debt/EBITDA of 3.6x remains elevated but is actively deleveraging with moderating capex.
AARTIIND.risk: A breakdown below 513.66 violates the base floor and 50 SMA support; cut losses immediately.

AIIL.technical: Positioned within 1.5% of the 608.31 pivot on strong 4.1× volume expansion, trading above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. RSI at 56 indicates unextended momentum, though multi-month overhead supply lingers near the 630-680 zone.
AIIL.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue rose +20% YoY to ₹1,448 crore and net profit reached ₹1,115 crore (+18% YoY), but prior quarters showed erratic drops (-97% in Q4). Volatile mark-to-market investment returns lack consistent O'Neil annual compounding.
AIIL.risk: A reversal below the 576.89 stop violates the pivot consolidation; exit promptly to limit downside.

AJMERA.technical: Executed a 20-day high breakout through 131.96 on exceptional 5.68× volume expansion, with RSI at 67 confirming robust accumulation. Price structure remains in a sound Stage 2 uptrend above rising key moving averages.
AJMERA.fundamental: Q1 FY27 sales grew +23% YoY to ₹320 crore, but net profit growth decelerated to +13% YoY (₹45 crore) from +114% in Q4. Operating margins are healthy at 29% and ROCE sits at 14.3%, but quarterly deceleration caps leadership.
AJMERA.risk: Slipping below 122.50 breaches the breakout bar low and pivot foundation; close out the position without hesitation.
